raw_review_excerpt:

No prior-round carried issues were specified. The plan is freeze-ready for its current authoring state (seeded draft entering grounding).

- 2. [NOTE] plan_readiness.py not verified to exist

rubric_cards.title: Claim Anchoring
rubric_cards.claim: Plan claims S4 scope is 'design-doc and slice-map mode' from the PRD execution map row, names specific test files and CLI commands as verify surfaces, and captures the V2 YAML absence via LBA1.
rubric_cards.evidence: PRD line 347 confirms S4 scope as 'design-doc and slice-map mode' with expected output 'workflow run against fixture request producing expected artifacts'. Design doc Mode B (lines 124-138) describes create-design-doc, create-slice-map, select-one-slice flow matching the plan. executor.test.ts, loader.test.ts, bundled-defaults.test.ts all exist at named paths. cli.ts:64 imports validateWorkflowsCommand and cli.ts:105 documents 'validate workflows [name]' subcommand. archon-piv-loop-codex-v2.yaml correctly does not exist (confirmed by read error); LBA1 in state.json blocks P1/P2 until it does.
rubric_cards.disposition: PRESENT — all load-bearing claims trace to inspected repo artifacts

rubric_cards.title: Disposition Matrix
rubric_cards.claim: The plan artifact is self-consistent, conversation evidence was not needed beyond the plan text, and campaign coverage was assessed for the S4 slice only.
rubric_cards.evidence: Plan frontmatter, phased execution, unresolved items, state.json, and verify commands are internally consistent. PRD execution map and design doc were inspected to confirm scope alignment. Only the S4 slice was reviewed; S1-S3, S5-S7 and the umbrella plan were not assessed for implementation status.
rubric_cards.disposition: PRESENT — artifact-primary review with PRD/design cross-check; campaign scope limited to S4 slice

rubric_cards.anchor: What was and was not inspected
rubric_cards.claim: Review covered the S4 plan artifact, its state.json, the PRD execution map rows, the design doc Mode B section, the three named test files, the CLI validate command, and the orchestration plan slice ledger. Not covered: S1-S3 implementation status (relevant to LBA1 satisfaction timing), runtime behavior of the validate or test commands, plan_readiness.py script existence.

issues.title: P0-T2 verify command is self-referential
issues.details: P0-T2's sole verify command greps the plan file itself for task IDs and keywords. This proves the plan text contains those strings but does not independently verify that the slice contract and doc surface are actually locked or consistent with the PRD.
issues.suggested_fix: Consider adding a cross-check command in P0-T2 that validates against the PRD or design doc (e.g., grep the PRD execution map row and compare to plan scope), rather than only grepping the plan's own text. This can be deferred to the grounding pass itself.

issues.title: plan_readiness.py not verified to exist
issues.details: P0-T1 and P2-T1 reference `plan_readiness.py` via the CODEX_HOME path. This script was not verified to exist on disk. If it is missing, those verify commands will fail silently or with an unhelpful error.
issues.suggested_fix: During the P0 grounding pass, confirm `plan_readiness.py` exists at the expected path and runs without error against this plan file. If it does not exist, replace or remove that verify command.
